title: Consultor Comercial Inside Sales | Afya Educon
description:
Overview

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Educação Continuada , mais especificamente na Educon ( MCP e FD ), para trabalhar de forma inicialmente remota e podendo evoluir para atuação híbrida na cidade de Rio de Janeiro.

Ao assumir o cargo de Consultor Comercial na Afya, seu objetivo principal será abordar e engajar leads com uma abordagem consultiva, entendendo suas dores e ofertando os produtos mais adequados dentro do nosso portfólio;

♿ Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Responsibilities

  • Engajar leads com uma abordagem consultiva, entendendo suas dores e ofertando os produtos mais adequados dentro do nosso portfólio;
  • Realizar contatos por WhatsApp, áudios e ligações;
  • Gerenciar o funil considerando os diferentes estágios em que os leads podem se encontrar;
  • Realizar sequências de contato e follow-up com os leads, tanto automatizados quanto personalizados;
  • Manter o CRM atualizado com informações precisas e bem redigidas;
  • Observar métricas e indicadores, visando melhoria contínua dos processos para trazer os melhores resultados.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo ou cursando;
  • Experiência em vendas ou qualificação de leads;
  • Experiência na utilização de softwares CRM;
  • Perfil perseverante, resiliente, positivo e organizado;
  • Capacidade para trabalhar com grande volume de contatos;
  • Habilidade de comunicação escrita impecável, garantindo clareza, profissionalismo e persuasão nas interações com leads;
  • Desejável: certificação online em Inside Sales (Hubspot, TISS, Universidade Rock, RD University, etc.);
  • Diferencial: familiaridade com a carreira e rotina em medicina.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação: 9h às 18h de segunda a sexta e sábado de 9h às 13h conforme escala.

Informações adicionais

❤️ GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time.

Confira os principais abaixo:

  • Para o dia a dia:
  • Vale-alimentação / refeição;
  • Flexibilidade de horários e alocações (para vagas Remotas);
  • Vale-transporte (para vagas Hibridas ou Presenciais);
  • UP na remuneração:
  • Multibenefícios: Benefício flexível via Cartão Flash para usar como preferir.
  • Família, Saúde e Bem-estar:
  • Gympass / Wellhub;
  • Psicologia Viva (plataforma online para consulta com psicólogo e nutricionista);
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);
  • Rede D\'Ór: suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros;
  • Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);
  • Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).
  • Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado:
  • Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA);

  • Programa de desenvolvimento para líderes;
  • Mentoria para Mulheres da Afya (MMA);
  • Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya.
  • ✍️ Diferencial para Professor Médico:
  • Assinatura premium do Afya iClinic e Afya Whitebook

description:
Overview

Somos formados por pessoas de diferentes idades e experiências profissionais. No processo de seleção, bem como no desenvolvimento de carreira, aplicamos critérios de não discriminação e igualdade de oportunidades, de acordo com a nossa cultura e nosso Código de Ética e Conduta. A Celeo apoia diversos projetos de cultura, educação, bem-estar, saúde, ações de cidadania, solidariedade, entre outros com o compromisso com a sociedade e acreditando que juntos formamos um time mais forte. Reconhecemos a importância das pessoas para o nosso negócio e buscamos diariamente a construção de ambientes propícios ao desenvolvimento, segurança e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, terceiros e prestadores de serviços, e ainda, da população próxima aos nossos empreendimentos, nos tornando um ótimo lugar para trabalhar todos os dias com #orgulhodeserceleo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar nas atividades relacionadas a gestão de ativos, no controle e melhorias dos ativos de transmissão com 5.239 km de linhas e 61 subestações de 500/230kV, presente em 10 estados. E atuação em ativos de geração com 6 usinas fotovoltaicas com 186MW.
  • Atuar na análise e aprovação na etapa do cadastro do item pelo solicitante no sistema.
  • Atuar nas etapas do fluxograma do processo de Gestão de estoque.
  • Atuar na análise, etapas do processo de Calibração e Manutenção dos instrumentos.
  • Atuar no acionamento, controle e acompanhamento de ações necessárias das garantias dos ativos.
  • Atuar no controle, análise, cadastro dos ativos e nas ações necessárias nas Ordem de Serviço (OS) no sistema de Gestão da Manutenção.
  • Elaborar, automatizar e manter dashboards analíticos e gerenciais em Power BI, contemplando indicadores como: Disponibilidade de ativos, MTTR, MTBF, Backlog crítico, Reincidência de falhas, Perdas energéticas (MWh), Performance e confiabilidade dos ativos;
  • Criar rotinas de reporte automatizadas, reduzindo esforço manual e aumentando a periodicidade e confiabilidade das análises
  • Desenvolver modelos analíticos e preditivos utilizando ferramentas de analise de dados, incluindo: Análise de tendência e degradação, Probabilidade de falha, Risco de indisponibilidade, Detecção de anomalias, Apoio à manutenção baseada em condição;
  • Aplicar conceitos de Confiabilidade de Ativos nas análises de dados, como: Criticidade, Modos e efeitos de falha, Ciclo de vida dos ativos, Integridade e risco operacional;
  • Atuar na modelagem e padronização de dados de ativos, incluindo: Hierarquia e cadastro de ativos, Eventos e ordens de manutenção, Localização, Criticidade e classificação;
  • Outras atividades delegadas pela coordenação/gerência pertinentes ao cargo.

Requisitos e qualificações

Necessário:
  • Ensino Superior completo (qualquer curso);
  • Conhecimento do Manual de Controle Patrimonial do Setor Elétrico (MCPSE).
  • Domínio do Pacote Office e Power BI.
  • Conhecimento em Python ou similar.
  • Conhecimento em Análise de dados.
Diferencial:
  • Ter atuado no setor de Transmissão de Energia.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de confiabilidade.
  • Conhecimento da ISO 55001.
  • Experiência na área de Gestão de Ativos.

Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil. Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente!

Local de Atuação

Rio de Janeiro, RJ (Iguá Rio de Janeiro S.A).

Main responsibilities

  • Realizar o acompanhamento jurídico e contratual da concessão;
  • Prestar assessoria jurídica às áreas internas em matérias contratuais e regulatórias e assegurar a conformidade das práticas operacionais com o Contrato de Concessão e a legislação vigente.
  • Acompanhamento Processual;
  • Apoiar em processos de pleitos de reequilíbrio econômico-financeiro e revisões contratuais;
  • Elaborar respostas a ofícios e manifestações da Agência Reguladoras, do Poder Concedente e demais stakeholders institucionais;
  • Gerir, administrar e prestar contas da documentação legal e regulatória da concessão, garantindo o cumprimento das obrigações contratuais e legais perante as Agências Reguladoras, o Poder Concedente e outros órgãos de controle;
  • Monitorar metas e obrigações contratuais, assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos previstos no contrato e em normativos regulatórios;
  • Acompanhar novos regulamentos, legislações e interpretações normativas, atualizando procedimentos internos e promovendo o alinhamento institucional às diretrizes da AGENERSA, ANA e demais entidades setoriais (como a ABCON-RJ).

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Direito,
  • Inscrição ativa na OAB;
  • Domínio no pacote Office, em especial no Power Point;
  • Experiência com direito administrativo e regulatório;
  • Experiência no segmento de infraestrutura;
  • Desejável conhecimento intermediário de Inglês.

Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PcD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação!

title: Principal ROV Specialist
description:
Job Overview

The Principal ROV Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex ROV (Mar)-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal ROV Specialist may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and is regarded as a specialist in ROV (Mar). As such, they must have in-depth expertise in ROV (Mar) as well as broad knowledge of the ROV (Mar) discipline within the Marine function.

Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Degree in Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in offshore remote subsea system design and operations
  • Min. 8 years of experience supporting construction projects
  • Good command of English both oral and written
  • Proficient in the use of subsea ROV & ROV tooling systems
  • Previous offshore experience
  • Proven experience working with ROVs and tooling packs
  • Willingness to travel
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in Subsea Remote Systems design, functioning, and operation (ROV, ROV Tooling, subsea architecture, connectors, flying leads…)
  • Extensive knowledge/expertise in the design, functioning, and operation of remote subsea tooling associated with ROV and subsea hardware operation
  • Good Project Engineering skills and experience
  • Previous knowledge in dealing with ROV and Subsea EPC contractors
  • Good understanding of QHSE
  • Proficient knowledge of technical software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor
  • Proficient knowledge of project software: Microsoft Project, Microsoft Office

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Oversee ROV requirements on assigned project
  • Oversee ROV Tooling Requirements
  • Oversee Commissioning Tooling Requirements
  • Carry out ROV access studies and checks
  • Desktop studies
  • Ensure efficient and excellent integration of the subsea interfaces of SURF project to the marine operations execution

Deliverables

  • Conduct live audits of ROV contractor's premises/offshore in conjunction with Marine QHSE and provide feedback on system and personnel performance/opportunities for improvement
  • Ensure ROV contractors comply with statutory and IMCA guidelines
  • Prepare ROV contractor mobilization audits to ensure readiness/compliance with contract specifications
  • Liaison with Clients / ROV contractors both on and offshore to confirm operational status
  • Research and assessment of latest ROV techniques/equipment so MDR remains up to date and for possible inclusion into Marine Operations/standards

Project Deliverables

  • Issue installation procedure for subsea hardware installation/operation
  • Issue equipment/material specifications for remote subsea tooling and installation aids
  • Provide expertise to the project team to review the subsea installation philosophy of the main subsea components (flexible, umbilical, suction pile, manifold, SDU, and flying lead installation) and proper implementation into the installation procedure
  • Provide input to subsea Pre-Commissioning / Commissioning activities for key contractors
  • Manage interface with subsea hardware EPC contractor and review subsea material delivered to enable a smooth integration of all supplied subsea components into the installation method
  • Ensure that the EPC Contractor meets the technical quality and timely delivery of their deliverables
  • Provide technical / construction support as part of the subsea team in dealing with key vendors
  • Participate in Installation Constructability Reviews and HAZID’s
  • Ensure that the offshore execution is performed safely, timely, and as efficiently as possible, providing quality reporting throughout the offshore period

Reports to

  • Functional: Director ROV Operations
  • Regional: MAO And Senior Manager Marine Operations
  • Project/Construction Manager when assigned to the project
  • Supervises: Ops Engineers/Field Engineers/Draftspersons
  • Liaise with: All Marine operations personnel, functional managers, Engineering design teams, project engineering, tendering teams, procurement/subcontract coordinators, and clients

title: Ubuntu Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring engineers to work across the breadth of our Ubuntu Engineering organisation - engineers who care deeply for quality, performance and resilience in software, engineers who are just as comfortable with designing and engineering new software as they are with packaging, integrating, testing and shipping the incredible catalog of open source software provided by the Ubuntu repositories.

Our engineers integrate the freshest open source software, provide robust upgrade paths and engineer the future of Ubuntu. Ubuntu is not just the world's most deployed open source operating system, it's a platform that enables innovation for millions of users across the globe. Our community represents the full breadth of the developer experience; from students, hobbyists and freelancers to high performance engineering and creative teams in corporate and academic environments.

Teams that ship Ubuntu

  • Foundations : maintaining foundational software: architectures, package managers, compilers, toolchains, bootloaders, filesystems and core utilities
  • Server : leading the design, evolution and future of our Ubuntu Server distribution
  • Desktop : driving Ubuntu Desktop, our future immutable desktop: Ubuntu Core Desktop, WSL, gaming technology, and a suite of modern applications for the desktop crafted with Flutter
  • Debcrafters : a new team responsible for the forward movement, maintenance and overall health of the Ubuntu archive: one of the most abundant repositories of open source software available today

Bring your existing expertise and learn new skills by working on one of the most prolific pieces of open source software. As an engineer working on Ubuntu you could work on any or all of the following categories:

  • Development : design, build and ship new foundational systems software and applications in Rust, Go, Flutter, and Python
  • Architecture : engineer the integration of open source from boot firmware to cloud applications deployment
  • Packaging : a combination of Debian and Snap packaging to ship software in the distribution
  • Automation : build and maintain the machinery responsible for building, testing and shipping Ubuntu
  • Distro Engineering : the maintenance and evolution of a Linux distribution and its repositories

This application track is suitable for those at the mid point in their career but perhaps not quite at the Manager/Lead level, with relevant skills to contribute to Ubuntu.

At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to engage with and contribute to the broader open source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community and contribute with enthusiasm and precision to a broad range of technologies.

Location

We have remote roles open in every time zone.

The role entails

Based on the first round of interviews, we identify specific teams where you might be an excellent fit and conduct second-round interviews with those teams. Our engineers are:

  • Designing, building and shipping software in Rust, Go and Python
  • Packaging, integrating, testing and uploading open source software to the Ubuntu repositories
  • Debugging system-level issues and delivering robust solutions
  • Authoring and improving technical and community documentation
  • Contributing to upstream and neighboring open source projects
  • Collaborating as part of a globally distributed team
  • Mentoring their colleagues to build skills and understanding
  • Developing and improving processes to more efficiently fulfill our goals

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations
  • A demonstrated passion for open source software
  • Significant experience with Rust, Go, Python, Flutter or C/C++
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience with Linux distributions and distribution engineering
  • Experience with software packaging and distribution mechanisms
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation
  • Performance or Security Engineering experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  2. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  3. Frontend: Building the “Control Room” and complex AI interfaces.
  4. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s “Visualizations” and that the “Data Pipelines” are reliably deployed by DevOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph .
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The 'Expert' : When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translate high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

The Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development .
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins , IoT, or Industrial Data.
  • Experience with GenAI/LLM architecture (RAG, Agents).
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

The Role

Reporting to the Solution Consulting Director and based in Brazil, the candidate will be responsible for all technical aspects of the sales cycle related to geomodelling solutions, while ensuring the highest standard of customer satisfaction. The candidate will play a key role in the development and execution of pre-sales activities for geomodelling workflows, with deep expertise in SKUA, RMS, and subsurface characterization.

Your Impact

  • Provide advanced technical support and consulting in Aspen SKUA and Aspen RMS geomodelling software.
  • Prepare, present, and propose workflows for structural modeling, property modeling, seismic interpretation integration, reservoir characterization, and uncertainty analysis.
  • Search, uncover, understand, and analyze client/prospect needs and requirements to grow or penetrate accounts.
  • Conduct technical presentations and demonstrations on the AspenTech SSE subsurface applications suite, with emphasis on SKUA and RMS.
  • Present integrated workflows combining geomodelling software with other tools in the AspenTech suite (e.g., seismic interpretation, petrophysics, flow simulation).
  • Conduct pilot projects showcasing geomodelling workflows, demonstrating differentiators of SKUA/RMS versus equivalent market solutions.
  • Co-develop sales proposals together with the sales team.
  • Run advanced demonstrations and presentations at customer sites, workshops, and trade shows.
  • Identify, evaluate, and recommend proof-of-concept and evaluation opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with users through personal contact, onsite engagements, and user group meetings.
  • Communicate with product managers and developers on issues identified from field observations and customer feedback.
  • Training – Deliver high-quality basic and advanced training on geomodelling workflows and modules within SKUA and RMS.
  • Support – Provide troubleshooting and advanced user assistance; own issues until resolution or appropriate escalation. Demonstrate proficiency with internal support procedures and tracking systems.
  • Professional Development – Continue to actively develop technical expertise in geomodelling methodologies, reservoir characterization, and integrated subsurface workflows. Seek opportunities for personal development of non-technical competencies.
  • Technical Reporting – Complete and submit Consultant Activity Reports after each project in a timely manner.
  • Provide feedback to R&D and Product Management to contribute to continued improvement of our geoscience solutions.
  • Software Consulting – Deliver consulting services to execute tasks and produce deliverables related to structural modeling, reservoir modeling, seismic-to-simulation workflows, and geomodelling.
  • Write papers or technical abstracts for local and international events, demonstrating the value of AspenTech SSE geomodelling technologies.

What You'll Need

  • BS in Geology, Reservoir Engineering, or related subsurface discipline; MS preferred with more than 5–7 years of relevant experience.
  • Advanced knowledge of geomodeling, reservoir characterization, structural modeling, property modeling, and uncertainty workflows.
  • Experience working with complex geological settings such as carbonates, unconventionals, tight sands, salt tectonics, and structurally complex reservoirs.
  • Expertise in handling subsurface datasets: seismic interpretations, well logs, geological maps, core data, and reservoir simulation grids.
  • Capable of conducting high-quality basic and advanced classroom training on SKUA and RMS modules and workflows.
  • Background in multidisciplinary collaboration to improve integrated interpretation and modeling results.
  • Experience with data management, quality control, and subsurface data integration workflows.
  • Proficiency with geomodeling applications, especially SKUA and RMS (mandatory).
  • Knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Excellent technical communication skills in English; Portuguese and Spanish strongly preferred.
  • Strong presentation and storytelling skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and willing to take initiative.
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team when required.
  • Collaborative mindset and willingness to mentor younger professionals.
  • Able to interact effectively with other departments and multidisciplinary colleagues.
  • Strong commitment to deadlines and customer satisfaction.
  • Comfortable working in a multicultural business environment.
  • Flexible – must be able to travel.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Venue Design Manager reports to FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and FIFA Senior Venue Design Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™ requires venue design of as a key central delivery to fully integrate and visually represent all operations, legacy information and complementary structures required for the tournament. The Venue Design Manager is responsible for leading and implementing the venue design from block planning through to final design across a cluster of official FIFA stadiums and venues.

Role to transition into onsite Venue Overlay Manager during final Event.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Raw Data Management

Application of FIFA Drawing Standards

  • Integration of operational content (space allocation, perimeters, flow data, capacities, space tags), legacy information (base infrastructure, legacy usage/annotation/signage) and complementary structures (fences, commodities, FF&E layouts etc.) as required.

Application of BIM 360 Workflows

  • Management and interaction of central database for drawing development, communication, change requests and publications.

Implementation of Space Requirements

  • Application of requirements according to FIFA Event Platform (EP) and venue limitations.

Drawing Publications

  • Delivery of drawings sets according to inspections and project timelines (site plans, levels, seating maps, pitch plans, catwalks, sections, detailed layouts etc.)

Ongoing Collaboration

  • Continuous collaboration and support for Venue Management and FIFA Functional Areas.
  • Collaborate with the Technical Services and Overlay teams, Functional Areas, stadium authorities, and other stakeholders to define, optimize and validate solutions, ensuring technical requirements are accurately reflected in designs and BoQs.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Degree in architecture, engineering, urban planning or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience managing multi-venue overlay projects, from design to delivery, preferably for major sporting events (e.g., FIFA, Olympic Games).

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a "deliver fast" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a 'deliver fast' mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Location

Fully remote position.

title: Bilingual Sap Tosca Consultant
description:
About TTC

The Testing Consultancy (TTC) is a global specialist software testing company with a focus on helping organizations transform the way they deliver quality software. We have broad capabilities across a wide range of testing areas including SAP testing and TOSCA automation that enable our clients to increase the speed and quality of software development while reducing risk and cost.

Perks of working for TTC

  • Open to C2C
  • Competitive Base Salary
  • Work Life Balance
  • Relaxed Work Environment
  • Growth and Development Opportunities

Summary

The primary purpose of the Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant role is to lead and deliver SAP testing and TOSCA automation services to customers using industry standards and best practices to meet TTC customer requirements. The Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant will work collaboratively to build and establish the overall QA process with a focus on SAP landscapes and model based test automation through TOSCA. Responsibilities for this position also include mentoring QA personnel on SAP testing methodology, TOSCA frameworks, automation strategies, and other technical aspects. The Bilingual SAP Tosca Consultant may also assist in general application support of SAP production applications and systems, managing relationships with business owners, software vendors, auditors, and internal IT teams.

The ideal candidate will have strong SAP functional knowledge, deep hands on experience with TOSCA automation, and the ability to lead both functional and technical discussions. They must be proactive, strategic, technically strong, and capable of performing hands on work as required.

Responsibilities

  • Consult with the customer on the design and implementation of comprehensive Test Activities across SAP modules and TOSCA automation that satisfy Test Objectives and ensure sustainable product Quality throughout the SDLC
  • Advise on all aspects of QA including SAP specific best practices, establishing metrics, applying leading TOSCA automation strategies, and developing tools and processes to meet quality goals
  • Develop, plan, execute, and maintain SAP test cases, TOSCA scripts, plans, and protocols for solutions under development
  • Participate in the deployment of SAP enhancements, upgrades, integrations, and major implementations
  • Complete User Acceptance Testing to validate the end to end business flow across SAP modules
  • Identify opportunities for SAP test process optimization and TOSCA framework improvements with a focus on continuous improvement and customer value
  • Establish and evolve formal QA processes for SAP projects ensuring that the team is using best practices and scalable TOSCA automation approaches
  • Act as a key point of contact for all QA aspects of SAP releases and TOSCA automation delivery while managing customer expectations
  • Work with project management to meet SAP testing milestones and deliver high quality automated and manual testing solutions on time
  • Lead, collaborate, and mentor QA team members on SAP testing methods and TOSCA automation best practices while sharing domain knowledge to expand team capabilities

Technical Skills

  • Hands on experience with TOSCA automation including modules, test case design, execution, and automation framework development
  • Strong knowledge of SAP modules such as FIORI, MM, PM, SD, FICO, PP and QM, BW, EWM, BPC, APO, or others
  • Experience automating SAP applications using TOSCA including navigation, test case recording, and building reusable automation assets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication with the ability to explain SAP and TOSCA technical concepts to internal and external stakeholders
  • Leadership skills with the ability to mentor QA professionals in SAP testing and TOSCA automation
  • Ability to work independently, meet SAP project timelines, and adapt to changing requirements
  • Experience with SDLC including SAP business planning, data analysis, functional requirements analysis, and application design
  • Strong decision making and problem-solving skills related to SAP functional and TOSCA automation challenges
  • Ability to evaluate information from multiple SAP sources, assess risks, prioritize user needs, and design appropriate test solutions
  • Experience working in Agile and Waterfall development environments
  • Knowledge of large-scale SAP deployments, implementations, support, and upgrade projects

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Systems, or Computer Science
  • 7+ years of experience in Software Development and Quality Assurance including User Acceptance Testing, Functional Testing, Performance Testing, Manual and Automated Testing. UAT experience is required
  • 3-6 years of SAP Functional Testing experience
  • 2-4 years of hands-on TOSCA automation experience
  • ISTQB Certification preferred

If your experience or qualifications are similar to our ideal candidate, please consider applying. Experience comes in many forms, skills may be transferable, but passion for your career cannot be substituted. At TTC, we recognize the value of diversity and the unique perspectives it brings. We encourage everyone to apply.

title: Host Broadcast Production Manager
description:
Host Broadcast Production Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high-pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high-quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

  • Troubleshooting Nível 3: Liderar a resolução de incidentes complexos que envolvam perda de pacotes, microbursts, latência elevada e falhas de protocolo (BGP session flapping, OSPF/ISIS adjacency issues).

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Telecomunicações, Engenharia Elétrica, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Roteamento Exterior; BGP (Border Gateway Protocol); Domínio em iBGP, eBGP, RRs (Route Reflectors), políticas avançadas de Path Selection, manipulação de atributos (AS_Path Prepending, MED, Local Preference) e uso de Community Strings.
  • MPLS Core; MPLS e VPNs; Experiência comprovada com LDP e RSVP-TE. Configuração e operação de VPN L3 (M‑BGP e VRFs) e L2VPN (VPLS ou VPWS/Ethernet VPN – EVPN).
  • Roteamento Interior; IGPs (OSPF ou IS-IS); Proficiência no design de áreas hierárquicas, otimização de métricas e garantia de convergência rápida. Preferencialmente com experiência em IS-IS.
  • Alta Disponibilidade; Resiliência e Convergência; Conhecimento prático em MPLS FRR, BFD e utilização de Non-Stop Routing (NSR) ou Graceful Restart (GR).
  • Hardware; Roteadores Carrier; Experiência de comando e configuração em plataformas de roteamento de alta capacidade (Ex: Linhas NCS/ASR da Cisco, MX Series da Juniper, ou plataformas Huawei/Nokia).
  • Endereçamento; IPv4 e IPv6; Planejamento de endereçamento escalável. Conhecimento em estratégias de transição IPv6 (Ex: Dual Stack, DS-Lite, NAT444).
  • QoS e TE; Qualidade de Serviço; Configuração de modelos DiffServ sobre MPLS, Policing, Shaping e classificação de tráfego para serviços com SLA.

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Installation Analysis discipline. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Installation Analysis team and other related teams and ensures they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master's degree preferred)
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable for onshore and offshore construction
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

Responsibilities

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Direct Engineering team when assigned as a Project Coordinator on projects
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short-term work activities in own area
  • Communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore, when required to do so
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter‑discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates; Provide similar support for Variation Orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close cooperation with other engineering disciplines, Planning, Fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in the preparation of estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and workhour estimates
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare Discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications, as required
  • Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Construction/Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare and review design reports
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • When assigned, assist procurement personnel in producing Discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing and reviewing requisitions, evaluating technical quotations and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Check engineering performed by others within the Discipline
  • Perform design verification through single-discipline check/inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary, and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Participate in internal, Customer, and third-party technical audits on engineering deliverables and vendor documents
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries, etc.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and of the discipline
  • In the Pipeline installation discipline, perform/review Pipeline Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for transportation and installation:
    • Submarine pipelines
    • Risers
    • Spools
    • PLETS and manifolds
    • Cables
  • In the Structural Installation discipline, perform/review Structural Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • In the Naval Installation discipline, perform /review Naval Architecture Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation
  • Additional skills (preferred, not mandatory) – perform/review designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as:
    • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
    • Loadout procedures and guidance during the operations
    • Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as floatover, stackings roll-ups, etc.
    • Weighing procedures
    • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
    • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
    • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures

Reports to: Discipline Lead Engineer
Liaise With: All Engineering disciplines, Fabrication Group, Safety Dept, Document Control, Procurement Group,
Subcontractors, Project Management Team, Vendors, and Customers
Supervises: Engineers

Missão

A Ipiranga está em busca de um(a) Gerente de Mercado Marítimo para liderar o desenvolvimento e a gestão de negócios no segmento de combustíveis marítimos, atendendo grandes operadores do mercado offshore de óleo e gás, transportadores fluviais e embarcações de apoio. Garantir soluções integradas e customizadas que unam fornecimento de combustível, serviços e infraestrutura, com foco em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e excelência no relacionamento com clientes estratégicos

Atividades e Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias comerciais para ampliar a participação no mercado de combustíveis marítimos.
  • Atender e expandir relacionamento com grandes operadores offshore de óleo e gás, empresas de transporte fluvial e operadores de embarcações de apoio.

  • Acompanhar performance dos contratos (volumes, margens, indicadores de satisfação) e implementar planos de ação para melhorias.

  • Liderar, treinar, engajar e desenvolver a equipe garantindo alta performance e evolução individual.
  • Mapear e eliminar gargalos da operação, implementando rotinas, rituais de gestão e boas práticas comerciais.
  • Atuar fortemente no uso de ferramentas digitais, CRM e automação para garantir escalabilidade e previsibilidade no funil de vendas.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Formação superior em Engenharia
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão comercial B2B, com atuação em combustíveis, óleo & gás, logística marítima ou offshore.
  • Vivência comprovada no relacionamento com clientes do setor marítimo (offshore, fluvial, apoio portuário ou navegação), com entregas consistentes.
  • Habilidade de comunicação, negociação e influência em todos os níveis.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de contratos complexos e negociações de alto impacto.
  • Perfil estratégico, com capacidade de execução e orientação para resultados.
  • Vivência com CRM e ferramentas de automação de vendas.
  • Inglês avançado.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Visão estratégica com foco em geração de valor para clientes e empresa.
  • Forte habilidade de negociação e gestão de relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Capacidade de articulação com diferentes stakeholders internos e externos.
  • Proatividade e resiliência em ambiente de alta complexidade e pressão.
  • Mentalidade inovadora, voltada para soluções logísticas e energéticas sustentáveis.

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão Comercial, Energia, Logística ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência no setor B2B (energia, combustíveis, logística, tecnologia ou serviços).
  • Rede de relacionamento consolidada no segmento offshore e fluvial.
  • Mentor mental growth mindset: alguém que desafia o status quo, busca inovação e não se limita a manter o atual.
  • Forte viés analítico: capacidade de interpretar dados para tomada de decisão estratégica.
  • Liderança inspiradora: foco no desenvolvimento do time, equilíbrio entre cobrança de resultados e motivação.

title: Senior Programmer
description:
**PLEASE REMEMBER TO ATTACH YOUR CV IN ENGLISH**

At NOV Subsea Production Systems (SPS), we develop solutions that power the industry that moves the world. Our flexible pipe systems rely on highly precise and reliable structural components.

As part of the Software and Architecture organization in Subsea Production Systems, the Senior Programmer will develop new and current software applications (in-house apps), that will directly impact the work in the departments of Subsea Production Systems.

You will be part of our newly established office in Brazil to improve our support to the production facility in Acu. The rest of the crew is situated in Brøndby, Copenhagen area, Denmark.

You will develop simple solutions to complex problems, work small, talk to end-users during the entire product development process, use your problem-solving approach, and be curious about monitoring the outcome of any release. In between, you will refactor your code on the go, handle non-urgent bugs or work on one of your side-projects.

About the role

As a Senior Programmer, you will be working with:

  • Internal stand-alone applications supporting different areas in Subsea Production Systems segment.
  • SQL databases.
  • Reduce complexity on current and future code and architecture.
  • Participate in technology projects across Subsea Production Systems.
  • Contribute to working smarter in the team.
  • Contribute to increasingly working with AI-applications/integrations.
  • Close end-user collaboration.

What you need to have

  • Important: Solid experience writing C# full-time.
  • Important: Experienced working with SQL databases.
  • Important: Full stack Engineer.
  • Important: Experienced GitHub and Copilot user.
  • B.Sc., M.Sc. in Engineering, Computer Science or similar fields or autodidact within software development.
  • Experience with Windows Presentation Foundation, Entity Framework Core and MVVM Toolkit.
  • Knowledge of packaging and deploying containerized applications, preferably using Kubernetes.
  • Important: Experienced GitHub and Copilot user.
  • Pro: Experience working in agile setups and product development environments.
  • Advanced English Skills

Location

Rio de Janeiro, RJ

What we are looking for

The role as a Senior Programmer is an extension of the role as Programmer, and for the experienced programmer proving consistent value creation, proactive attitude, self-driven, a fast learner and high level of the relevant competencies. You will develop simple solutions to complex problems, work small, talk to end-users, release often, and be curious about monitoring the outcome of any release. In between, you will refactor your code on the go, handle non-urgent bugs or work on one of your side-projects.

What we offer

At NOV, we value the well-being, development, and long-term career growth of our employees. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer:

  • Health Plan and Dental Plan for employees and eligible dependents;
  • Meal Voucher and Food Voucher ;
  • Childcare Assistance ;
  • Life Insurance ;
  • Profit Sharing Program (PLR) ;
  • Transportation Voucher *;
  • Gympass *;
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) ;
  • Harvard ManageMentor – access to free online courses in partnership with Harvard University.
  • You can work remotely 2 days per week.
  • Occasionally you will have to go to our production facility in Acu and talk to end users

(*optional programs that may include employee participation)

Send your resume and cover letter in English.

Bring your energy, your ideas, and your talent -together, we go further. Join NOV Subsea Production Systems and be part of a team that moves the world!

title: FPSO HSE Advisor
description:
Contexte et environnement

O FPSO HSE Advisor trabalha em regime de rotação (14x14– 2 pessoas em rotação para 1 posição) e passa 100% do tempo offshore em ambiente de campo com as seguintes características:

  • Contexto de Afretamento e Operação;
  • Ambiente multicultural com nível de atividades em rápido crescimento;
  • Contexto desafiador de legislação e licenciamento de HSE;
  • O FPSO HSE Advisor possui forte interface com equipe de HSE do Contratado no site. Questões importantes e incidentes devem ser imediatamente reportados ao CSR/RSES no local.

Activités

  • Facilita e assegura a conformidade com as regulamentações e normas brasileiras de HSE em todas as operações;
  • Mantém registros e documentação relacionados a HSE e garante que o Contratado cumpra os requisitos acordados de retenção de registros conforme contrato;
  • Apoia o CSR/RSES na implementação do processo de notificação de incidentes da afiliada;
  • Mantém o dossiê de HSE atualizado com arquivos e registros conforme exigido pelas Regras da Companhia (CR) e Especificações Gerais (GS);
  • Compila e registra informações e documentação de HSE solicitadas/liberadas por órgãos reguladores durante auditorias, inspeções ou investigações no site;
  • Participa de HAZID, HAZOP e Análise de Causa Raiz; participa dos programas de Segurança da companhia como “Safety Green Light”, “Life Saving Checks”, auditorias de Permissão de Trabalho, palestras de segurança; participa da reunião semanal de segurança;
  • Assegura que todos os procedimentos operacionais usados para Descarga Operacional e Plano de Medição de Gás (como parte da ISO 14001/ISO 50001) sejam seguidos dentro das limitações do processo e alinhados aos objetivos de Produção/Injeção.

Requisitos Legais e da Companhia

  • Facilita e assegura a conformidade com as regulamentações e normas brasileiras de HSE em todas as operações;
  • Mantém registros e documentação relacionados a HSE e garante que o Contratado cumpra os requisitos acordados de retenção de registros conforme contrato;

Responsabilidade Operacional, Cultura de HSE e Comunicação

  • Apoia o CSR/RSES na implementação de reuniões semanais de HSE, comitês de HSE no site, visitas e inspeções de HSE;

  • Implementa iniciativas dos programas de Segurança da companhia como “Safety Green Light”, “Life Saving Checks”, auditorias de permissão de trabalho, Diálogo de Segurança etc.;
  • Participa e promove a cultura de segurança a bordo do FPSO (compartilhamento de comunicados de segurança).

Gestão de Riscos

  • Identifica e aborda riscos de HSE e fornece orientação sobre medidas preventivas e corretivas; elabora planos de ação conforme solicitado;
  • Garante que todas as operações e atividades sejam submetidas à análise de risco;

  • Utiliza ferramentas disponíveis (LSC – “Life Saving Checks”) para garantir que as operações sejam gerenciadas adequadamente.

Meio Ambiente

  • Projeto de Monitoramento Ambiental (PMA);
  • Projeto de Controle da Poluição (PCP);
  • Apoia pessoal treinado na implementação das ações exigidas pelo PMAVE (monitoramento dos impactos de plataformas e embarcações sobre a avifauna);
  • Administra sistemas de rastreamento de registros ambientais no site.

Preservação da Saúde e Higiene Industrial

  • Verifica se o Contratado cumpre todos os requisitos regulatórios para preservação da saúde no site (PPRA etc.);
  • Apoia a implementação de planos e programas de higiene industrial no site;
  • Verifica a seleção e aquisição adequadas de EPIs e equipamentos de segurança da Companhia no site.

Treinamento e Competência

  • Educa, motiva e treina pessoal da Companhia e do Contratado em questões de HSE;
  • Controla a conformidade da matriz de treinamentos de HSE do Contratado;
  • Aplica o PEAT (Projeto de Educação Ambiental dos Trabalhadores) para todo o pessoal a bordo do FPSO.

Gestão de Emergências

  • Apoia a aplicação do sistema de resposta a emergências conforme requisitos do documento de interface;

description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are implementing a strict Medallion Architecture to organize petabytes of industrial data. This role is for a Data Engineer who excels at transforming raw chaos into structured, queryable assets.

You will build and maintain the ELT pipelines that move data from 'Bronze' (Raw) to 'Silver' (Cleaned) and 'Gold' (Aggregated). You will work with Delta Lake (On-prem/Databricks ), Polars and Airflow to ensure data quality and availability for Data Scientists and the Knowledge Graph.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Development: Develop and maintain robust Airflow DAGs to orchestrate complex data transformations.
  • Data Transformation: Use Spark (when scale requires) and Polars to clean, enrich, and aggregate data according to business logic.
  • Architecture Implementation: Enforce the Medallion Architecture patterns, ensuring clear separation of concerns between data layers.
  • Performance Tuning: Optimize processing workflows (Polars/Spark) jobs and SQL queries to reduce costs and execution time; make intelligent decisions on when to use Polars vs. Spark.
  • Deployment & Operations: Manage code deployment to on-prem and cloud infrastructure, including containerization and environment configuration.
  • Data Quality: Implement comprehensive data validation checks and quality gates between medallion layers.
  • Data Cataloging: Maintain the metadata and catalog entries to ensure all data assets are discoverable and documented.

The Technology Stack

  • Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
  • Data Processing: Polars (primary for ETL), PySpark/SQL (for massive scale)
  • Compute : Single-node workers (Polars), Databricks/Spark clusters (when scale requires)
  • Storage: Delta Lake, Parquet, S3/Blob Storage, MinIO
  • Language: Python 3.12+ (w/ Polars), SQL.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Apache Airflow and Databricks .

Como Assistente de Loja na H&M, você desempenhará um papel fundamental na criação de uma experiência excepcional para o cliente. Você dará as boas-vindas aos clientes, os guiará pela loja e os apoiará a encontrar o que precisam enquanto apresenta nossos produtos. Nossas lojas são o coração de nossa empresa

Como parte da dinâmica equipe de loja, todas as funções – assistentes de loja, coordenadores de departamento, gerentes de loja, visual merchandisers e analistas administrativos e financeiros – contribuem para criar um ambiente inspirador e acolhedor. Você também se conectará com a equipe de área mais ampla, colaborando entre as lojas para compartilhar insights e impulsionar o sucesso juntos. Ao lado de sua equipe, você desempenhará um papel vital em ajudar os clientes a se sentirem confiantes e expressarem sua individualidade com as últimas tendências e estilos atemporais. Ao construir conexões significativas com os clientes em nossas lojas, tornamos a moda acessível e sustentável para todos.

Estamos à procura de pessoas com...

  • Experiência em atendimento ao cliente em moda, varejo ou áreas afins.

E as pessoas que são...

  • Apaixonado por moda e por oferecer uma experiência excepcional na loja, promovendo nossos produtos e impulsionando as vendas.
  • Prosperando em ambientes colaborativos e dinâmicos.
  • Comunicativo, criativo, curioso para trabalhar com tecnologia de loja, com forte vontade de aprender e se desenvolver.
  • Flexível e orientado para a ação.

O H&M Group é uma empresa global de fortes marcas e empreendimentos de moda

Nosso objetivo é provar que não há compromisso entre design excepcional, preços acessíveis e soluções sustentáveis. Queremos liberar a moda para muitos, e nossos clientes estão no centro de todas as decisões que tomamos.

Somos formados por milhares de colegas apaixonados e talentosos, unidos por nossa cultura e valores compartilhados. Juntos, queremos usar nosso poder, nossa escala e nosso conhecimento para impulsionar a indústria da moda em direção a um futuro mais inclusivo e sustentável.

POR QUE VOCÊ VAI ADORAR TRABALHAR AQUI

No Grupo H&M, temos orgulho de ser uma empresa vibrante e acolhedora. Oferecemos aos nossos funcionários benefícios atraentes com amplas oportunidades de desenvolvimento em todo o mundo.

Nossa singularidade vem de uma combinação de muitas coisas – nossa cultura inclusiva e colaborativa, nossos fortes valores e oportunidades de crescimento. Mas, acima de tudo, são as nossas pessoas que nos tornam quem somos.

Dê o próximo passo em sua carreira junto conosco. A jornada começa aqui.

Somos uma empresa inclusiva e com oportunidades abertas para todas as pessoas. Incentivamos a participação de mulheres, negras, negros, LGBTQIA+ e PcDs nos nossos processos seletivos.

title: Fonoaudiólogo(a) – Recriando Reabilitação – Rio de Janeiro
description:
Overview

Fonoaudiólogo(a) – Recriando Reabilitação – Rio de Janeiro

O Fonoaudiólogo (a) é responsável por realizar avaliações, diagnósticos e intervenções em pacientes com distúrbios de comunicação, voz, audição e deglutição, atuando sob supervisão e contribuindo para a promoção da saúde e bem-estar dos pacientes. Atua em ambientes clínicos, aplicando técnicas específicas e acompanhando a evolução dos tratamentos. Sua atuação envolve também a orientação de pacientes e familiares, além de colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para oferecer um atendimento integral e de qualidade, promovendo a reabilitação e a melhoria da qualidade de vida dos indivíduos atendidos.

Responsibilities

  • Realizar avaliações fonoaudiológicas utilizando instrumentos e protocolos específicos para identificar alterações na comunicação, voz, audição e deglutição, garantindo precisão nos diagnósticos iniciais.
  • Aplicar técnicas de intervenção e reabilitação fonoaudiológica de acordo com o diagnóstico, adaptando estratégias às necessidades individuais de cada paciente, incluindo exercícios, orientações e uso de recursos auxiliares quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar a evolução dos pacientes durante o tratamento, ajustando as intervenções conforme a resposta ao tratamento e documentando todas as atividades realizadas de forma detalhada e organizada.
  • Prestar orientações a pacientes, familiares e equipes de saúde sobre estratégias de comunicação, cuidados com a audição, higiene vocal e prevenção de distúrbios, promovendo a conscientização e o autocuidado.
  • Participar de reuniões multidisciplinares, contribuindo com informações clínicas relevantes para o planejamento e execução do tratamento, além de colaborar na elaboração de planos de cuidado integrados.
  • Realizar atividades de educação em saúde, promovendo ações de conscientização sobre a importância da saúde auditiva, vocal e de comunicação na comunidade e nos ambientes de trabalho.
  • Manter registros atualizados de prontuários, relatórios e demais documentos clínicos, garantindo a confidencialidade e o cumprimento das normas éticas e legais da profissão.
  • Participar de treinamentos, cursos e atualizações profissionais para aprimorar conhecimentos técnicos e metodológicos, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados.
  • Auxiliar na organização e manutenção do espaço clínico, garantindo condições adequadas para a realização dos atendimentos e o bem-estar dos pacientes.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de saúde na implementação de programas de prevenção, triagem e promoção da saúde auditiva e da comunicação, atuando de forma proativa na comunidade.

description:
